comments.content: Casting `assets.updatedAt` to `date` before taking `max` drops the time-of-day. Previously `lastModifiedAssetTimestamp` was the exact `updatedAt` value, so multiple asset updates on the same UTC day now produce the same timestamp and may also serialize as a date-only value. Take `max` over `assets.updatedAt` without the `::date` cast to preserve the existing API semantics.
